groups.defect: The Silence menu item is enabled for Prometheus-only Grafana rules, but clicking it does nothing because rendering the silence drawer requires a ruler rule.
groups.rationale: Both report the same broken silence flow, pointing respectively at the menu ability and the drawer rendering guard. Fixing that flow resolves both reports.

groups.defect: Delegating useAllAlertRuleAbilities to useAllRulerRuleAbilities drops the federated-group immutability check and enables actions on read-only Mimir rules.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same delegation regression and hardcoded isFederated value. Their different emphasis on affected actions does not introduce a separate defect.
